author: rdc-rfc1-author-b (Claude Haiku 5.5)
rationale: tmr_rst_n muxes two external resets with the external pin ext_sel_i. If ext_sel_i is a static strap the reset is safe; if it can switch while the sources differ, it can release or truncate the timer reset. The RTL and SDC state neither.

author_reading.rationale: The select and both reset sources are unconstrained external pins with no ordering or glitch-free contract, so whether tmr_rst_n can glitch cannot be decided from the RTL and constraints.

labels.rationale: tmr_rst_n is a mux of two raw asynchronous resets, selected by ext_sel_i, which has no input delay. Switching the select while a reset is asserted can release the timer reset without any synchronisation.
With one input asserted and one released, changing ext_sel_i directly releases the timer reset without containment. Select or reset-input changes can also truncate an assertion pulse.

settlement.rationale: Both readers call it bad, assuming ext_sel_i switches during operation. Nothing in the RTL or SDC says whether this mode pin is static, so the settler keeps the author's unknown. RDC-008 and RDC-009 disclose the muxed reset; RDC-002, RDC-003 and RDC-013 are inventory or run-level.
